lines: A million followers doesn't mean a million customers.
This creator looks huge. But what if most of their audience is wrong for your brand?
Follower count is a vanity metric.
What actually matters is audience fit, real engagement, and who those followers really are.
A smaller creator with the right audience can outperform a massive one.
Stop buying followers. Start buying influence.
Yoloco. Influencer marketing, powered by data.
